actors.name: LinkedIn Trends Actor
actors.description: Scrapes LinkedIn trending posts, articles, and updates based on keywords

actors.name: YouTube Trends Actor
actors.description: Scrapes YouTube trending videos in specified categories

actors.name: Instagram Trends Actor
actors.description: Scrapes Instagram trending posts and hashtags

setup_instructions.step1: Create actors in Apify for each platform using their web scraping templates
setup_instructions.step2: Configure each actor to output JSON format
setup_instructions.step3: Set up Box integration in Apify to push results to /raw-data/{date}/{platform}/trends.json
setup_instructions.step4: Enable cron scheduling for daily 12:00 AM UTC execution
setup_instructions.step5: Store Apify API token in .env as APIFY_API_TOKEN
